source.live_to_final_difference: Only set_volume tool description/docstring and prompt documentation corrected after live runs; executable AST unchanged. Final descriptions were not replayed through Claude.

runtime.dependency_environment: isolated environment synchronized from uv.lock; no dependency or lockfile changes

fixes: Network MTU defaults to 0, meaning omit the optional wire field and use the backend default; explicit values are retained.
Legacy volume attach resolves instance_name/instance_id/server_id through the existing server-volume service; owned server and volume are required.
Both volume attachment paths use SDK server/volume argument order; detach validates all target servers before issuing any mutation.
Both search tools forward offset and case_sensitive; search slices matching results before enriching them.
MCP search requests use one matching lookahead record for accurate has_more while preserving legacy list returns for existing service callers and existing query metadata.
Identified prompt-template keyword mismatches and unsupported image/volume filter instructions were corrected.

identity.admin_usage: Fixture setup and cleanup only; read and write functional checks use ordinary users.

unit_tests.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/mcp73-locked-env UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/mcp73-uv-cache uv run --locked --no-sync python -m pytest -q tests
execution_notes: A sandboxed initial targeted run hung at thread-based tests and was interrupted; rerun outside that restriction completed.
pytest -q tests failed collection with two ModuleNotFoundError errors for scripts; python -m pytest -q tests completed with the repository root on sys.path.
A broad pytest -q invocation returned 195 passes but includes a root manual script returning bool and a PytestReturnNotNoneWarning; the authoritative unit scope is tests/, 194 cases.

template_keyword_check.limitation: Literal keyword-name check only; not all tools, required values, service behavior or model output.

backup_infrastructure_incident.cause: Cinder backup returned errno 13 Permission denied in NFS backup storage, outside MCP; created directly through Cinder API.

backup_infrastructure_incident.recovery_note: Six fresh backups were tested after the operator correction; original failed object was cleaned, not retried in place. The fresh backups do not prove every pre-existing shard directory is writable.

intermediate_fixed_run.note: Completed and cleaned before the final search-metadata refinement; not substituted for final-source results.

historical_evidence.note: Earlier same-day evidence consolidated here. Historical results do not validate the final source; original failures and limitations are preserved.

limitations: Same-URL duplicate registration was not established as a product defect: distinct URLs and single-entry attempts also failed before tools. The fresh model-only preflight still failed with credit/balance category, so no further paid Claude calls were made.
The final source and revised prompt were not replayed through Claude; previous 41 template CLI attempts/73 tool calls belong to the pre-fix source only.
Only 14 unique tools and their stated scenarios were live-retested, not all 105 tools/actions or every returned field.
The 41 literal template checks cover keyword names for four tool schemas, not every template example, required value/type or natural-language response.
No guest SSH/CPU/I/O, backup restore/checksum, production end-to-end TLS, LDAP deployment, 1000-node scaling or revocation SLA validation.
Parent read/load and child write tests use actual TCP MCP endpoints and actual OpenStack APIs; original template Claude tests are historical. No mocked API responses were used for live cases.
